clips.title: The story
paras: Blackchar Cave is a mysterious, sealed-off cavern tucked into the southwestern crags of Searing Gorge, close to the base of Blackrock Mountain. Its entrance is choked with impassable rubble and rock.

Tucked away against the scorching crags near the approaches to Blackrock Mountain, Blackchar Cave presents a solid wall of stone where a deep cavern entrance might once have been. Heavy rubble and scorched slag choke the opening, preventing anyone from exploring whatever tunnels lie deeper within the mountain roots. The desolate terrain around it is scorched by ash and magma, offering little comfort to wanderers.
